_comment: The one table every binding's test of its 410 classification reads (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md, "Build-level revocation", A 410 on a tag; public issue #625). Each case is one 410 body, as the bytes the fetch layer read (body_text encoded as UTF-8, or body_hex), the code it maps to, and for CHTYPES_ARTIFACT_REVOKED the text that follows "<url> answered 410 Gone: " and the advisories the typed error carries (each of the six fields a string, "" where absent). The rule: the body must be UTF-8 JSON whose errors[0].detail.revoked is an object to be CHTYPES_ARTIFACT_REVOKED; anything else is CHTYPES_SOURCE_RETIRED, whose message is tests/fixtures/retired-message's. A repeated key reads as its last value. Each advisory string is made safe as the retired message is (control and bidirectional-formatting code points removed, cut to 256 code points with U+2026), and one that is not a string, is empty once made safe, or whose raw token holds a lone surrogate escape is absent.

cases.name: contract-revoked
cases.why: the agreed body (public issue #625): errors[0].detail.revoked an object, two advisories, newest build first
cases.body_text: {"errors":[{"code":"DENIED","message":"this tag's every build is revoked","detail":{"revoked":{"repository":"chtypes/v2","reference":"26.13.6.1","advisories":[{"id":"GHSA-fx01-test-0001","url":"https://github.com/Wave-RF/chtypes/security/advisories/GHSA-fx01-test-0001","class":"over-accept","summary":"filter over-accept in fixture advisory 1","build":"20261012.000002","superseded_by":"20261019.000001"},{"id":"GHSA-fx01-test-0002","url":"https://github.com/Wave-RF/chtypes/security/advisories/GHSA-fx01-test-0002","class":"crash","summary":"a crash on a malformed DateTime64 in fixture advisory 2","build":"20261001.000001","superseded_by":"20261019.000001"}]}}}]}
